name: Powdery mildew
summary: A white superficial fungal growth that forms expanding powdery colonies on leaves, stems, petioles, and reproductive tissue.
exclusions: Residue follows droplet outlines after spraying
The pale area is inside the tissue and cannot be disturbed

progression.description: Colonies merge across leaves and stems.
Tissue yellows or dies and reproductive material may be contaminated.

confirmation: Use a plant diagnostic lab when legal or commercial decisions depend on certainty.
immediateActions: Isolate affected material and reduce spore movement.
Stop overhead wetting and review humidity/airflow.
correctivePlan: Use legal stage-appropriate controls and sanitation.
Remove heavily affected tissue without dispersing spores.
prevention: Maintain clean intake material and stable humidity.
warnings: Do not consume visibly mold-contaminated material.
Do not assume every white mark is mildew.

sources.title: First Report of Powdery Mildew Caused by Golovinomyces ambrosiae on Cannabis sativa in North America
supportedClaims: Golovinomyces ambrosiae causes powdery mildew on Cannabis sativa and produces superficial white colonies on susceptible tissue.
